Pays 20% of your HP and adds triple that to a strike on the enemy with the most HP!
Drops a smoke bomb here (3 turns). Allies in the smoke take half damage!
Reels in the curtain, pulling enemies in your row toward you!
Pours molten copper into the cone ahead (3 turns; enemies in it take damage). Hotter for each fallen ally!
Next enemy turn, enemies that ram your allies get 2 Curses. The higher their ATK, the heavier!
Drains nearby enemies. Half heals you; half is stored for your next strike!
Saturn's ring: swings enemies on the ring around to the opposite side of you!
Burns away every Poison and sticky wall. Each one burned makes nearby enemies' Burn hotter (ATK ×0.35–0.65)!
Pierces a vertical line. The fewer enemies on it, the harder (ATK ×3.0 on one)!

A clear river runs sideways (3 turns): allies in it heal, enemies drift downstream!
Three roots rise in columns (3 turns). Enemies crossing them take damage and get pulled in!

The cave door opens: hits every enemy, ×2 on those under half HP. +10% gauge per KO!
Lowers a drawbridge ahead (3 turns). Allies crossing it get ×1.5 momentum!
Calamity swirls: hits every enemy. The more enemies, the more all allies heal!
A lunar calendar: cross, circle, then the whole board. The full moon delays enemies!

A flaming tape measure shoots straight ahead. Farther enemies take harder hits!

Firecrackers pop on the nearest enemy and jump to those around it. More enemies, longer chain!
Sets balls left and right (3 turns). Bump one and it flies into an enemy!
Plants a sapling where an ally fell. Two rounds later, they return at full HP!
Seed pods burst and scatter around you. Next round they sprout and hurt enemies that touch them!

Shadows race back from where you stopped (up to 3 spots), grinding down enemies on the way!
Pays a little HP to pelt every visible enemy. The fewer you can see, the heavier each stone!
Leaves wildfire along your path (2 turns). Enemies that step on it Burn!
A robe of fire until your next shot ends: Burns what you touch, hotter each touch (up to ATK ×0.6)!
Leaps onto the farthest enemy. The farther the leap, the harder (up to ATK ×1.5). Burns those around!

Retraces every path your allies flew this round, hitting the enemies on them all over again!
Sets a springboard ahead (3 turns). Allies who jump from it heal allies where they land!
Allies near the walls take half damage, up to 3 times!
Kudzu vines pull in the 3 nearest enemies and tether them there for 2 turns!
Snipes the farthest enemy from the watchtower. The farther, the harder!
Turns to mist and reappears behind the nearest enemy, striking it at once!
Fireworks burst where enemies crowd most. Burns them; the more enemies, the harder (ATK ×1.0 with 4)!

Splints the nearest ally: a bigger heal the weaker they are, and they survive at 1 HP until the enemy turn!
Stamps the 3 nearest enemies with a Mark (3 turns); the nearest one skips its next action!
Throws a boomerang ahead. After the enemy turn it flies back and hits the band again (ATK ×1.1)!
Sucks up every gem on the board. Gauge for each one!
Squirts ink in a cone: Marks enemies and drops their defense to 0 — longer the closer (2–4 turns)!

Light curves around to hit every enemy hidden from this ally’s sight!

Stars burst around you and the nearest ally. Closer: stronger. Farther: wider. Both get ATK +20%!

Sticks burrs on every enemy. The more enemies, the heavier the Curse (up to ATK ×0.45)!

Shakes every enemy with mistletoe on it, knocking loose one gem per stage it has grown!
